subject: food-technology
title: Macro Nutrients
welcome_lead: Carbs, protein and fats — the big three.
meta_desc: KS3 food: carbohydrates, proteins, fats explained.
final_note: Three macronutrients your body needs in good amounts.

concepts.def: Solid at room temp — butter, lard.

walkthroughs.body_html: Simple carbs (sugar) give fast energy then crash. Complex carbs (wholegrain bread, oats) release energy slowly — keeps you going for hours.
Saturated fats (butter, fatty meat) raise cholesterol — limit. Unsaturated (olive oil, oily fish, nuts) are healthier. All fats are high in calories.
1 g of carbs or protein = 4 calories. 1 g of fat = 9 calories. That's why fatty foods are so energy-dense.
